summary.text: Shena Chapman is an independent candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jeffrey Mursau (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Chapman said she has worked as a bank teller, small business owner, paraprofessional, home health caregiver and self-employed cleaner.

paragraphs.text: Chapman said in the Ballotpedia survey that she is a wife, mother and longtime resident of the 36th District.
She described her campaign as "People Before Politics" and said that, as an independent, she is not beholden to a political party.
Chapman said her priorities include addressing PFAS contamination and clean drinking water, supporting public schools, and government that is transparent and fiscally responsible.
